text:
sarah (CEO): quick post-all-hands note on the reorg + headcount Qs. i know there were lots of DMsposting the operational bullets here. ask short q's and we'll answer.
jen (Recruiting): is this a hiring freeze or reprioritization?
dave (CTO): reprioritization. gating now focuses on Serving/runtime, Dedicated capacity, and active customer SLAs for the next 2 quarters.
lisa (Dir Eng): TL;DR: latency/reliability/autoscale teams get priority. other teams compete for remaining slots.
maria (People Ops): process: managers open a ticket in internal/hires, tag @jen + @lisa, add one-line impact statement. weekly triage.
sam (Eng): internal transfers? do they get priority?
maria (People Ops): yes: post in #internal-moves and cc your manager; internal moves are expedited in triage.
ada (Product): how do PMs justify a new headcount?
ada (Product): (typo; meant ada)
ada (Product): can we fast-track product hires tied to renewals?
ada (Product): ok corrected to ada
ada (Product): can we fast-track product hires tied to renewals?
jen (Recruiting): mark the ticket "urgent-customer" with contract/SLA and it jumps to top.
lisa (Dir Eng): org structure note: we're consolidating two small infra squads into "Serving Core" and "Platform Services". no mass moves; a few TL swaps expected. visual org map by Fri.
dave (CTO): hiring mix: aim ~60% senior+, ~40% mid-level; juniors allowed with a clear mentorship plan.
sarah (CEO): comp bands unchanged; exceptions handled by People Ops.
sam (Eng): will interview loops change?
jen (Recruiting): yes  leaner panels for infra to speed decisions; updated loops go out this week.
ada (Product): sponsorship/relocation impact?
maria (People Ops): existing offers unchanged. new reqs needing sponsorship flagged at intake for regional review.
sarah (CEO): timeline: org map by Fri, role mapping/backfills next 2-3 weeks, prioritized reqs start immediately.
jen (Recruiting): note: if a role is deprioritized we'll notify candidates and pause further interviews.
lisa (Dir Eng): managers: DM me for 1:1s if you need help mapping teams.
sarah (CEO): we'll keep this thread updated with the headcount sheet + org diagram. if people want an AMA, we'll schedule a short follow-up. :thumbsup: 
sam (Eng): thanks  this helps.
oncall-bot: all-hands notes uploaded: internal/allhands/2026-03-19-followup.md
